reproduction.note: seed-0 reference; other seeds are not expected to reproduce it

folds.probe: registered m1a shared joint L32/D labels, SeedSequence([seed,family_index,2201])

settings.spread: population standard deviation and range of draw AUROCs; full size one draw
settings.bootstrap: mean AUROC over subset draws first, paired within participating fold intersections; family mean equal weights
settings.family_mean: equal weights over requested families; smoke has add3 only
settings.inner_class_failures: number of outer subsets unable to form four valid inner folds; scores unavailable
settings.nonconvergence: all fits retained, counts summed over subset draws; family mean counts averaged
